lines.zh: 二相缓缓前行，发出沙沙声。
lines.en: Duo moves slowly, making rustling sounds.

lines.zh: 二相在地面上摩擦发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Duo makes hissing sounds as he rubs against the ground.
Duo gently touches the ground with his tentacles.
Duo lowers his tentacles as he walks.

lines.zh: 二相发出细微的咕噜声。
lines.en: Duo makes a faint gurgle sound.

lines.zh: 触手在二相身边轻轻摆动。
lines.en: Tentacles sway gently around Duo.

lines.zh: 二相的触手发出轻微的响声。
lines.en: Duo's tentacles make soft noises.

lines.zh: 二相的触手在空气中摩擦。
lines.en: Duo's tentacles rub against the air.

lines.zh: 二相发出低沉的咕哝声。
lines.en: Duo makes a deep grumbling sound.
Duo moves slowly.

lines.zh: 两副面孔轮流望向前方。
lines.en: My two faces take turns looking ahead.
I drag my shadow down the stone hall.

lines.zh: 二相静静地站立着，触手不动。
lines.en: Duo stands still, his tentacles motionless.

lines.zh: 二相的触手缠绕在一起。
lines.en: Duo's tentacles intertwine.
Duo's eyes glow faintly.
Duo's tentacles tremble gently.
Duo gazes into the distance.
Duo waits quietly.

lines.zh: 二相的眼睛似乎在闪烁。
lines.en: Duo's eyes seem to flicker.
Duo's tentacles gently sway.
Duo's tentacles lightly touch.
Duo watches quietly.

lines.zh: 二相注意到玩家，触手收紧。
lines.en: Duo notices the player, his tentacles tighten.

lines.zh: 二相的触手迅速伸向玩家。
lines.en: Duo's tentacles rush towards the player.
Duo's eyes fix on the player.

lines.zh: 二相发出低吼，触手收紧。
lines.en: Duo growls lowly, his tentacles tightening.

lines.zh: 二相的触手准备攻击玩家。
lines.en: Duo's tentacles prepare to attack the player.

lines.zh: 二相的触手缠绕着玩家。
lines.en: Duo's tentacles wrap around the player.

lines.zh: 二相的眼睛闪烁着光芒。
lines.en: Duo's eyes glow with intent.
Duo's tentacles reach for the player.

lines.zh: 二相发出嘶嘶声，触手收紧。
lines.en: Duo makes hissing sounds, his tentacles tightening.

lines.zh: 二相的触手迅速靠近玩家。
lines.en: Duo's tentacles rush close to the player.
This time I switch to the slow strike.

lines.zh: 我这副身体撑不住两套打法
lines.en: This body cannot carry two fighting styles at once.
Help me!
This hurts...
I'm falling...
Switching to the slow one this time.
I can't take it...
I'm dying...
Please help...
The nightmare is draining out of me.

lines.zh: 你散发的光芒引来了我的注意。
lines.en: Your glow caught my eye.

lines.zh: 别靠近，这里的食物很少。
lines.en: Stay back, there's little food here.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲似乎不适合我。
lines.en: Your armor doesn't fit me.

lines.zh: 这片梦境适合我的梦魇。
lines.en: This nightmare fits my dreams.

lines.zh: 我从不信任容易获取的猎物。
lines.en: Easy prey never fits my fancy.
Your breath startled me.

lines.zh: 我需要梦之尘来强化我。
lines.en: I need dream dust to strengthen me.

lines.zh: 这里的食物不够我填饱肚子。
lines.en: The food here is not enough for me.

lines.zh: 你的存在让我感到不安。
lines.en: Your presence unnerves me.

lines.zh: 我的攻击能让你记住我的名字。
lines.en: My attack will make you remember me.
I blocked your path.
You can't avoid my attack.

lines.zh: 你的力量无法穿透我的盔甲。
lines.en: Your strength can't penetrate my armor.

lines.zh: 你的速度不及我之万一。
lines.en: Your speed is but a fraction of mine.
I crushed your attempts.

lines.zh: 我的攻击让你无所遁形。
lines.en: My attacks leave you nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 你试图伤害我，却不知死活。
lines.en: You tried to hurt me, but you don't know what you're up against.

lines.zh: 我的力量比你想象的要强大。
lines.en: My strength is greater than you imagined.

lines.zh: 你的攻击让我更加警惕。
lines.en: Your attacks make me more cautious.
I won't let you go.

lines.zh: 两种出手方式，得配两种性情。
lines.en: Two ways to strike need two matching tempers.

lines.zh: 我不会轻易放过我的目标。
lines.en: I won't easily let my target go.
My mate must fit me.

lines.zh: 找到合适的配偶是我的首要任务。
lines.en: Finding a suitable mate is my top priority.
I choose my mate carefully.

lines.zh: 我不会让任何人干扰我的选择。
lines.en: I won't let anyone interfere with my choice.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣必须能与我共存。
lines.en: My mate must coexist with me.

lines.zh: 我需要找到合适的伴侣。
lines.en: I need to find a suitable mate.

lines.zh: 我不会轻易放弃我的选择。
lines.en: I won't easily give up my choice.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣必须是独一无二的。
lines.en: My mate must be unique.
Sssss, don't try to run!
Your Ender meat, got it.
You're too close to my nightmare.
Feel my fangs!
Taste of nightmare, delightful.
Ha, my nightmare feast.
Your scream, my melody.

lines.zh: 梦魇中的美味，非你莫属！
lines.en: Dinner in the nightmare, just for you.
You can't escape my nightmare!
Your pain, my dinner.
I'm here, Nightmare prey.
Dream devour you, gone forever.
Your soul, my food.
I'm here, for my nightmare.
Your blood, feeds the dream.
You're my nightmare prey.
My nightmare, your nightmare.
Dinner in the nightmare, only you.
My nightmare, your end.
Something living is on the nightmare floor.
This face has seen you.
The other face is awake too.
This time I switch my strike.
Guests are not welcome on this floor.
I will try a different approach.

lines.zh: 两层梦境之间，你卡住了。
lines.en: You are caught between two layers of dream.

lines.zh: 我换招的间隙你别眨眼
lines.en: Do not blink between my shifting attacks.
The quick strike comes first; the heavy one waits behind it.
Dream devours you!

lines.zh: 慢慢打一下，再快快打一下。
lines.en: One slow blow, then one fast.
Harvesting Nightmare prey.
My nightmare feast starts.
Your death, my victory.
The hunt in the nightmare begins!
Your end, my start.
The feast in the nightmare begins.
This time I come in slow.
No, this time I come in fast.
My two faces are arguing.
The heavy strike is winding up.
The light strike arrives first.
You cannot read my next move.
Even I must guess at it.
The nightmare makes me switch hands.
Break the rhythm and you panic.
I press in on your flank.
Duo roars, sharp claws strike!
Shimmer in the darkness, rip flesh!
Shadow attacks, deadly strike!
Slow but deadly, biting damage!
Darkness swallows, lethal strike!
Ghostly kiss, deadly damage!
Shadow rush, lethal bite!
Slow but lethal, claw attack!
Torn apart in nightmares, deadly damage!
Shadow strike, lethal hit!
Quick light blows, barely a sound.
A heavy blow dents the stone floor.
That one was slow. This one is fast.
I switch faces and switch my strength.
A claw sweeps across your chest.
You guessed my rhythm wrong.
Both faces bite at once.
The nightmare makes me strike faster.
You blocked only the first blow.
This one lands heavy.
Inferno calls, Duo emerges!
Nightmare world, Duo born!
Shadow falls, Duo awakens!
Darkness, Duo descends!
Maw of hell, Duo appears!
Nightmare depths, Duo spawns!
Heart of darkness, Duo born!
Below the abyss, Duo awakens!
Land of shadows, Duo born!
Nightmare depths, Duo descends!
On the first nightmare floor, I take shape.
Both faces open their eyes at once.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧出两种疼
lines.en: The fire leaves two different kinds of pain on me.

lines.zh: 我受伤了...，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm hurt — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我需要休息，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I need rest! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 救救我，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Help me! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 这感觉糟透了...，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: This hurts — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我要倒下了...，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm falling — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我受伤了，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm hurt! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我受够了...，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I can't take it — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我要死了...，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm dying — and the void makes it worse.
